name: ahk-harness
goal: The static half of a gate for AutoHotkey v1, so crew-written AHK can be judged before it is run: a lexer that knows code from comments and strings, a safety scanner that refuses anything able to touch Kris's real desktop, and a reader that checks the contract's functions exist and are not stubs. Kris asked for an AHK v1 module; AutoHotkey can press keys in whatever window has focus, so the gate comes first.

tasks.instructions: The masked text must have exactly the same length and line breaks as the source, including a trailing  on each line. Keep the opening and closing quote characters of a string; blank only what is between them. A ';' is a comment only at the start of a line or right after a space or tab. Block comments are whole lines, opened by a line starting with /* and closed by a line starting with */.
tasks.test_instructions: Check the exact masked strings from the contract table, that len(mask(s)) == len(s) with Windows line endings, a ';' inside a string, a;b, an escaped `;, doubled quotes, a one-line /* x */ that still opens a block, and unterminated on a string left open.

tasks.instructions: You MUST import code_lines and unterminated from ahk_lex and never inspect a comment or a string yourself. Every report must be exactly the sentence the contract gives, with the word as written in the source. A word preceded by a backtick or a '.' is not the command.
tasks.test_instructions: Prove words inside strings and comments are ignored, a banned word right after a string is still caught, whole-word and case-insensitive matching, the allowed #Include, and the sorted order when several problems share a line.

tasks.instructions: You MUST import code_lines from ahk_lex. A line like 'if (x) {' is not a function because 'if' is a keyword. Count braces across lines to find the end of a function; braces inside strings and comments are already blanked by code_lines.
tasks.test_instructions: Walk the contract example, then prove keyword lines are not functions, a call is not a definition, nested braces end in the right place, parameters lose ByRef, defaults and '*', and top_level ignores constants and directives.
